Name: Mauling Skull
Components: S, V, M (A jawbone cracked in half)
Description: You beckon forth the vertebral spine and skull of a giant skeleton formed from thick black mist, having it whip out to target another creature within reach and sink it’s teeth into that poor soul. You gain 3 Poise and then perform a ranged spell attack against a creature within reach, dealing 2d8 piercing damage and an additional 3d6 necrotic damage if you trigger a Posture Critical with this spell. Furthermore, if you trigger a Posture Critical with this spell the Critical’s damage is necrotic and the target creature gains 2 Poise count.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the piercing damage increases by 1d8 and necrotic damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd. It also generates 1 additional Poise count for each level above 2nd.
